mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 20 trading days compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior 20 trading days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.5% and remains above for 5 consecutive trading days, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in industrial production indicates strengthening labor market and manufacturing activity, jointly driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising INDPRO fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) above 1,150,000 units signals robust consumer demand and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when HOUST > 1150.0 and economy is in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the prior 20 trading days indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances where PAYEMS increased over prior 20 trading days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,200,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals robust residential construction and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary policy response to inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for three consecutive months signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 for three consecutive months and economy is in manufacturing slowdown regime, or Rank IC < 0.03.
